verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an online business-registry and filing portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights about a user's filings or records. The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions anywhere. The closest features, text/email notices of record changes and filing reminders, are rule-based alerts, not AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
